01 — Who we arePaleo Pro · Wholesale Brand Deck
Est. 2013 · Vista, California · Made in the USA
The same way since day one

Clean.
Simple.
Complete.

Paleo Pro is a food brand, not a supplement brand. We make animal-based protein from two clean sources — grass-fed beef and cage-free egg whites — and we leave out everything else.

It started in 2013 in our founder Doug's kitchen. After a life-altering accident left him unable to walk, he rebuilt his body with real food and went looking for a protein powder that matched the way he ate. He couldn't find one, so he made one. The formula hasn't changed since: two clean proteins, one complete scoop.

Over a decade later, Paleo Pro is on shelf at Sprouts Farmers Market and Whole Foods Market nationwide, has served more than 100,000 customers, and still prints every ingredient on the front of the bag — because the whole list fits.

Our promise

If it doesn't need to be in the bag, it isn't. No whey, no dairy, no soy, no fillers, no shortcuts.

What we stand on
  • CleanIngredients you can name — five in a flavored bag, three in Plain Naked.
  • CompleteBeef and egg together carry every essential amino acid.
  • UnfussyHonest value. No proprietary blends, no theatre.
  • Raised rightGrass-fed, pastured cattle. Cage-free egg whites. Made in the USA.
  • EnduringOne formula, one rule, since 2013.

02 — Why beef & eggPaleo Pro · Wholesale Brand Deck
The science is on the side of the scoop

Two proteins.
Nothing to
work around.

Most protein powders need 15–25 ingredients to approximate what animal protein does on its own. Grass-fed beef protein isolate gives strength; egg white protein — the reference protein that others are measured against — completes the amino profile. Together they cover all nine essential amino acids in one 30 g scoop.

07 — Proof & standardsPaleo Pro · Wholesale Brand Deck
Tested, not just claimed

Every batch,
verified by an
independent lab.

"Clean" is the easiest word in this industry to print and the hardest to prove. So we don't prove it ourselves. Every production batch goes out for third-party testing, and we publish the results — not on request, but as standard.

  • Heavy-metal panel on every production batch — lead, arsenic, cadmium, mercury
  • Label claims verified — the protein on the front is in the bag
  • Full certificate of analysis, published on paleopro.com
